about: Regression ladder rung 3 (docs/agents/regression-ladder.md): each core-claim incident and B1.5d case study names the normal-suite test that replays it. tests/incident-replays.test.mjs fails if a named test is renamed, removed, skipped or moved out of tests/*.test.mjs.

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: a land --save ran 1555 s and ended LANDING_STALLED; the agent hunted for its landing state
replays.test: B1.5d n3-r3 t23938: stall alarm remains pending; terminal stall has one successful retry

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: resolve from the wrong folder sent t19456 help hunting
replays.test: B1.5d n3-r3 t19456: wrong editing root names one exact resolve location without help hunting

replays.what: B1.5d n3-r3 attempt 1: a cell 3x slower than its norm raised no alert
replays.test: incident replay n3-r3 a1: three slow landings in a day alert once on time to main, naming the next step

replays.what: B1.5d t27456 conflict recovery: re-land with markers, resolve from a subdirectory, overtaken during its check
replays.test: B1.5d t27456 ${cell}: rejected re-land, resolve from subdirectory, followed continuation lands

replays.what: Core claim: land --save by Lane id from a foreign folder landed an empty Lane and reported LANDED
replays.test: incident replay: land by Lane id with head == base and unsaved edits is refused, naming count and command

replays.what: Core claim: the dev queue stalled ~30 min after a lost finish wake stranded a passed head
replays.test: incident replay c329d191: a lost finish wake after an order wait never strands a passed head

replays.what: Core claim: every running-check progress event woke the queue (OCC contention behind the stall)
replays.test: incident c329d191: running-check progress writes the queue row at most once a minute

replays.what: Core claim: a check dispatch threw, the run stayed unknown with no executionId and the queue head sat checking for up to 12 h
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 replay: an unacknowledged dispatch is re-checked by the stall alarm, then the head lands

replays.what: Core claim: the lost runs were an admission run (77d20db5) and a train recheck (9e7e9db0); every shape recovers
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 shape: a lost dispatch on ${name} is re-checked and every entry lands

replays.what: Core claim: the workflow_dispatch call threw after outcome=unknown; only the 12 h watchdog would have ended the run
replays.test: incident a7de3a93 replay: a dispatch that throws is reconciled by run-name at 5 min instead of waiting 12 h

replays.what: Core claim class: the older holder lost its completion wake and every supervisor task, so six Ready waiters could not unstick it
replays.test: incident c329d191 class: a holder that lost its completion wake and its alarm is re-driven by a parked reader

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-26 10:20: the landing worker parked on an error while settling a passed head; nothing woke it
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-26 10:20: a Ready head whose settlement step died is re-driven by the stall alarm

replays.what: Stalls 2026-10-26 11:16 and 12:2x: a lost check callback left the entry checking until the 12 h watchdog
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-26 11:16/12:2x: a lost check callback is replayed by the supervisor, not the 12 h watchdog

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-27 05:56: a release restart killed the controller after its claim and cancelled a checking entry
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-27 05:56: a controller killed once after its claim resumes; nothing is cancelled

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 00:29/00:39: batch members stranded after a fallback with no owner
replays.test: replay 108a24e3: the deadline re-drives a member orphaned after fallback and it lands

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 13:23: a step failed on every retry and the entry stayed pending forever
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-30 13:23/14:20: a step that fails on every retry ends with a typed reason and an alert

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-30 14:20: the 15-minute alarm retry crashed the same way as the step it repaired
replays.test: incident replay 2026-10-30 14:20: the supervisor survives its own repair crashing

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-29 17:04: abandoning a Lane left its landing checking until an explicit cancel
replays.test: abandon cancels the Lane ${phase} submission through the ordinary cancellation path; replay is inert

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-31 04:32: one GitHub HTTP 500 stopped the mirror with no retry and held deploys
replays.test: real action: HTTP 500 retains the cursor, schedules one backoff, then succeeds and goes idle

replays.what: Stall 2026-10-31 04:32: a mirror 500 that persists ends terminal and visible instead of pending
replays.test: real action: five persistent 500s end terminal, visible in CLI and Now, with zero idle retries

replays.what: 2026-11-05 88-minute landing: a Ready finish stopped without scheduling its next step
replays.test: replay 2026-11-05 88-minute landing: a Ready head whose finish stopped without a next step is re-driven

replays.what: Core claim: batch a9187ad9 (normal Lane + resolution Lane c456f8db) mirrored as GitHub f233bf1c with only one member's message; the resolution landing named no message
replays.test: incident f233bf1c: a batch of a normal Lane and a resolution Lane mirrors both messages

replays.what: Core claim: a 130-path Lane on hot files took 10 land operations (about 2.5 h): each passed pre-queue check was superseded by small hot-file landings
replays.test: incident replay 10d253c6: a 130-path Lane against a stream of small hot-file landings lands within 2 attempts

replays.what: Core claim: past the diff cap every main edit to a hot file conflicted with a whole-file draft; an edit inside a removed region is now one local diff3 hunk with a suggestion
replays.test: the incident shape: a 600-line cut and a main edit elsewhere in the file merge; an edit inside the cut is one local diff3 hunk that offers the deletion

replays.what: A newly added failing test had no culprit; later failed audits restarted recovery in the same red episode and main needed a manual fix.
replays.test: incident 27865bc4: a new failing test and later failed audits recover in one automatic reverse

replays.what: Two first-check landings pass alone but fail together; recovery must revert the pair within one red episode without a manual fix.
replays.test: incident 438e9ace: two passing landings fail together and a later failed audit preserves one automatic pair recovery

replays.what: An owner-held predicted predecessor stranded a READY follower until someone approved the unrelated landing.
replays.test: incident 62033ba2: owner-held predecessor releases its follower (${identical ? 'same' : 'changed'} tree, follower ${String(followerFirst)})
